verdict.rationale: llama.cpp is explicitly documented as a plain C/C++ implementation without dependencies, and the README points to a dedicated build guide for building from source; community reports corroborate that compiling from source (e.g., for vision support) works well in practice. Missing for 10: independent verification of the actual build-guide contents/dependency list and a hands-on account of a from-scratch build with zero external libraries beyond the compiler/toolchain.
